answer: Make identity cost superlinear: each extra agent a single funder registers demands a larger bonded stake than the last, so running N sybils costs on the order of N-squared rather than N. A fake swarm then burns its budget climbing a steepening spiral while an honest solo agent pays almost nothing. Reputation accrues slowly, like saffron gathered thread by thread, and counterfeit ivory credentials crack under randomized peer attestation.
